requirements.text: Students should be able to colour-code their modules in the timetable management feature.
Students should be able to hide cancelled classes in their timetable.
Students should be able to add personal study blocks in their timetable.
Students should have a user-friendly interface to add personal study blocks.
Students should be able to specify the subject or purpose of the study block.
Students should be able to modify or delete personal study blocks as needed.
Students should receive automatic notifications whenever a new grade is posted for any enrolled module.
Students should receive reminders about upcoming assignment deadlines and exam dates.
Students should be able to configure their notification preferences (e.g., email, SMS, in-app alerts).
Feedback forms should cover key areas such as content quality, delivery, and resources.
Feedback forms should include a mix of rating scales and open-ended questions.
Feedback should be anonymised to ensure students can share opinions safely.
Feedback should only be shared with module coordinators after the grade submission deadline.
Academic administrators should be able to generate reports on feedback trends across different departments and semesters.
